variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: .308 Win.
variants.info: Swap your caliber over to .308 Win. Increases magazine capacity, velocity, and treats your rifle closer to a standard light sniper.

variants.name: 6.5 Creedmoor
variants.info: Swap your caliber over to 6.5 Creedmoor. Faster projectile velocity and improved performance at longer range.
